items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I got a friend of the one. That was running by Sydney Keaton in the Sonny South. Yeah. I knew it.

ctx.x: Did you ever, uh, I hear you had a band of your own called the Sonny South Band, was that
right? No, that was my band of my own. Was it? No, not me. I never played in that band even. I got a friend of the one. That was running by Sydney Keaton in the Sonny South. Yeah. I knew it.
Did you ever have a band of your own under your own name?
